text:
Samira N.: hey everyone — Samira here, joined SRE two days ago. I'm scheduled for my first rotation next week but hit a couple of blockers: runbooks index returns 403 and my PagerDuty says 'not eligible'. Who's the right person to add me and pair for shadows? :wave:

Ibrahim H.: welcome Samira! :tada: file the access form at https://wiki.internal/access-requests -> choose 'oncall-runbooks' and 'oncall-eligibility', then paste the ticket id. I'll add you to the PD schedule once Okta sync completes.

Samira N.: filed PRR-6120 and OKTA-10555. Also the bastion SSH times out for me — jumphost unreachable.

InfraTeamBot: Okta sync started for user "Samira N." -> group "sre-oncall" (audit id: f4e1). Bastion request queued (request id: BH-221).

Lori W.: I can be your shadow. I'm free Tue 09:00-11:00 PST or Thu 14:00-16:00 PST. For bastion I can open a 24h pubkey window — DM your github handle. For the sim, join #eng-oncall-sim and run `sre-sim start --user samiran`.

Samira N.: thanks Lori — github handle samiran. Okta ticket shows 'complete' now but PD still says not eligible.

InfraTeamBot: Okta sync complete: user "Samira N." added to group "sre-oncall". Bastion pubkey added for user "samiran" (expires in 24h).

Ibrahim H.: added you to PagerDuty schedule, should be live. Run a PD test: `pd trigger --user "samira.n@redwood.com" --note "oncall test"`. Confirm you get mobile + email. Also small checklist before shadow: read incident-lifecycle.md, skim runbooks for services you're paired with, run PD test, complete one sim.

OncallBot: Assigned checklist to Samira N.: read runbooks, PD test, 1 sim, attend shadow with Lori. Due: 4 days.

Samira N.: PD push came through and I can SSH to bastion now. Appreciate the quick help! One last question: are runbook edits allowed during probation?

Lori W.: PRs are fine — require runbook-owner + SRE reviewer while on probation. Typos and clarifications usually merge quickly. No direct pushes to main.

Samira N.: perfect, thanks all. I'll run the sim tonight and see you Tue. :rocket:
